name: Developers

final:
Update the PostgreSQL connection settings and add a retry when the connection times out.

Keep the existing Kubernetes deployment unchanged.

name: Medical students
title: Turn a case discussion into organized study notes.
raw: for tomorrow's case discussion first review the patient history actually start with the presenting complaint next compare the medication list with the history then write down three questions what changed since the last visit which details still need clarification and what should we discuss with the tutor finish with a short summary for our study group
final:
Tomorrow’s case discussion

Preparation
• Start with the presenting complaint.
• Compare the medication list with the history.

Questions
1. What changed since the last visit?
2. Which details still need clarification?
3. What should we discuss with the tutor?

Finish with a short summary for our study group.
note: Work through the preparation and questions out loud. Keep the structure in your notes.

name: Writers
title: Keep the story going while you take a walk.
raw: um she reached the platform at dawn actually just before dawn the last train had already gone and for the first time she was glad
final: She reached the platform just before dawn. The last train had already gone, and for the first time, she was glad.
note: Phone workflow concept for the upcoming Android app.

name: Work & business
title: Write the follow-up while the details are fresh.
raw: hi jordan um thanks for walking through the proposal I will send the updated budget before our meeting on thursday actually friday at six thirty pm best noah
final:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for walking through the proposal. I’ll send the updated budget before our meeting on Friday at 6:30 PM.

Best,
Noah
note: A correction and a spoken time become a clear client email.

name: Students
title: Talk through the paragraph you’re working on.
raw: um public transport shapes the way people use a city it influences where they work how much time they spend travelling and which neighborhoods they can reach
final: Public transport shapes the way people use a city. It influences where they work, how much time they spend travelling, and which neighborhoods they can reach.
note: Keep the idea moving while the punctuation and cleanup are handled.

name: Remote workers
title: Give your team a useful update without switching focus.
raw: the design is ready for review um I am waiting on the updated copy so let us move the handoff to thursday thanks for the quick turnaround thumbs up emoji
final: The design is ready for review. I’m waiting on the updated copy, so let’s move the handoff to Thursday. Thanks for the quick turnaround 👍
note: A natural spoken update becomes a message in the conversation you already have open.

name: Podcasters
title: Capture the points you want in your show notes.

final:
For the show notes:

• How the project started
• What changed after the first launch
• The advice we want listeners to take away
note: Turn your own spoken summary into useful episode notes.

name: Parents
title: Get a message written when your hands are occupied.
raw: um I will pick up the groceries after school please add apples milk and bread to the list see you at home heart emoji
final: I’ll pick up the groceries after school. Please add apples, milk and bread to the list. See you at home ❤️
note: Everyday messages and spoken emoji, without needing both hands on the keyboard.

name: Accessibility
title: Use your voice for more of your everyday writing.
raw: um please send the appointment details by email I would like to check the time and address before I make travel arrangements
final: Please send the appointment details by email. I’d like to check the time and address before I make travel arrangements.
note: Hands-free recording offers another way to write when typing is uncomfortable.
